title: PICTOS API v1 componer request 1.1.0
description: POST /api/v1/componer. One valid NLU document in, one accepted composition out. The composition language and deterministic root follow nlu.lang.

nlu.description: Any valid NLU 1.1.0 document, typically the output of comprender. Rejected with input_contract_invalid otherwise.

config.description: Subset of PICTOS GlobalConfig that affects COMPONER.

model.description: Model id from the pictos.net catalog for this phase. Availability changes over time, so it is not enumerated here: a retired or unknown id is rejected with invalid_request (/model). Omit to use the current default, reported in the response under model.requested.
